name: Arabic Hour
functions: Tap-to-play: 20 Egyptian phrases and Tut lines in your own recorded gruff voice
Points per kid (3 kids), turn-taking, Tut tut-tuts and praise
Favors: family goal and rewards
Parents settings for names and points

name: Live Tut
theme: Sunny desert, big animated cartoon face
functions: Live talking Tut (Google Gemini Live, Algenib voice): grumpy, roasting, teaches Egyptian in context
Face moves with his voice: mouth, eyes, brows and moods
Tut gives points himself; up to 4 kids
Memory of past hangouts; voice recognition for kids and parents
Parent instructions mode (say "Seriously") including changing scores
Setup link to copy everything to a phone; Practice tab kept
note: Needs a Google Gemini key in Parents.

name: Tomb Tut
theme: Dark torch-lit tomb, realistic dusty little mummy
functions: Everything in Live Tut
New face: a realistic generated mummy picture brought to life
Ember eyes that glow, glance, roll and blink; mouth opens with his voice
Flickering torchlight and floating dust
This versions catalog (Parents > App versions)
note: Needs a Google Gemini key in Parents.

name: Talking Tut
theme: Dark torch-lit tomb, realistic dusty little mummy
functions: Everything in Tomb Tut
Lip sync: the mouth reads each sound of his voice and forms speaking shapes: closed, wide "ah", stretched "ee", rounded "oo", narrow "s"/"f"
Lips snap shut on m, b and p sounds
note: Needs a Google Gemini key in Parents.

name: Real-mouth Tut
theme: Dark tomb, realistic dusty little mummy
functions: Everything in v4
Mouth made from 30 real mouth pictures (vowels in 2-3 sizes, plus b/p, f, s, sh, th, l, r, k, w)
Picks the shape from the sound and how loud it is, and moves smoothly between shapes; no ring around the head
note: Needs a Google Gemini key in Parents.

name: Cool Tut
theme: Dark tomb, realistic dusty little mummy (30-shape mouth)
functions: Everything in v5
Talks like a real person: answers when spoken to, keeps a back-and-forth going, stays quiet when people are talking to each other
Cooler, drier character; jokes are rationed, not in every line
Rotates his jokes: remembers his recent lines and avoids repeating them; 'woke up after 3,000 years' bits used rarely
Voice-ID notes no longer make him butt in
Screen stays on while Tut is awake; long chats reconnect on their own instead of switching off
Parents > Tut's memory now lists what he remembers, grouped by kid; in instructions mode he reads it out per kid when asked
Stronger voice recognition: many samples per person, 'Add more' recordings, learns from play; about 3x fewer misses in testing
Chaos watch: screaming is called out within ~4 s; nonstop talking-over-each-other gets checked every ~6 s instead of waiting for it to end
Can look things up online (Google Search): weather, facts, news, scores; kid-safe answers
note: Needs a Google Gemini key in Parents.
